CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether this OFFERING as a whole appears on the GTM Offerings Dashboard listing. Only meaningful on the offering's own tile section (Section_Key__c='tile', Template_Type__c='offerings-listing') -- it is not a per-section field. Draft hides the offering from the dashboard; Draft (the default) shows it. This is NOT the same as Status__c, which means "this section's own edit is unpublished," and is NOT the same as Active__c, which hides one section without touching the offering's dashboard visibility.
CustomField.label: Offering Status
